column3: So compared to most people in this room, my history with Reborn is pretty short.
In 2017-ish, I found out about the game through a friend of mine tweeting about it.
He posted a picture of the inside of Sweet Kiss Candy shop, I mistook it for a Pokecentre, and immediately decided I had to play this game.
Of course, then I actually started playing, and... Well, let's just say Julia kicked my butt so badly I put the game down and forgot about it.
In February of 2019, I decided to try it again, and-- while I wasn't much better-- I at least had more patience.
I ended up falling completely in love with the game.  The characters, the music, the world...
It made me, and continues to make me, so happy.
Reborn actually ended up reigniting my passion for writing.
More than that, I fell in love with the community!
I made some incredible friends, some of whom are in this room with me, and I wouldn't trade them for the world.
In late 2020, I messaged Ame, asking if she needed any help with last-minute things.
A while later, she decided she could use some help with the Nightclub, and so here I am!
All the Trainers you can battle in the Battle Pavilion, their little dialogues, were my department!
I also worked on some of the characters' chatter while hanging out in the club itself-- so go say hi to folks, if you haven't already!
This game and community mean so much to me, and I'll always be grateful for how kind and wonderful everyone's been.
I'm a Canadian gal, and at the time this is being published, I'm in my late twenties.
Apart from Reborn (and sundry other fangames, and Pokemon in general) I'm also a musician, animal lover, and storyteller.
I'm so passionate about stories, in all their forms.  How they can bring people together, heal people, bring joy and catharsis...
Definitely one of my favourite things to think about.
Here, have some BP for your time!
